name: demo-spike-30
comment: Descriptive input. This is the ONLY thing a user edits. Everything downstream is generated.

gas.comment: Ratio of specific heats. 1.20 is a common placeholder for hot combustion products. For a cold-gas or air demonstrator use 1.40.

nozzle.comment: truncate_fraction 1.0 is the ideal full spike. Real engines truncate hard; 0.20-0.30 keeps most of the performance.

chamber.comment: Geometry of the annular chamber, not its combustion. contraction_ratio is A_chamber/A_throat and sets the chamber outer radius. converging_length_mm is the axial run over which the duct contracts to the throat; too short and the cowl wall turns sharply, too long and the engine grows for nothing.

geometry.comment: voxel_size_mm is the resolution of the whole model. Halving it multiplies memory by ~8. Start coarse. wall_thickness_mm hollows the centrebody and sets the cowl shell; the cavity is an eroded offset so at the spike shoulder the wall comes out slightly thicker, never thinner.

mesh.comment: Used only by the Python STL exporter in validate/mesh_export.py, which is the fallback path for machines without the PicoGK runtime. The C# model voxelises instead and ignores this section.
